simple.prompt: The lead engineer ___ architected the new microservices platform was promoted today.
simple.explanation: 'Who' adalah relative pronoun untuk merujuk pada subjek manusia (the lead engineer).

simple.prompt: We reviewed the technical blueprint ___ was submitted by the contractor yesterday.
simple.explanation: 'Which' atau 'that' digunakan untuk merujuk pada benda mati, hewan, atau konsep abstrak ('the technical blueprint').

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan relative clause menggunakan 'who'.
simple.targetSentence: The woman who called you left a message.
simple.explanation: Subject (The woman) + relative clause (who called you) + main verb (left a message).
hints: Mulai dengan 'The woman who called you'.

simple.prompt: The startup company ___ innovative software disrupted the market was acquired yesterday.
simple.explanation: 'Whose' adalah relative pronoun kepemilikan (possessive: perangkat lunak milik startup tersebut). 'Who's' adalah singkatan 'who is'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan relative pronoun 'where' untuk tempat.
simple.targetSentence: This is the laboratory where we conduct experiments.
simple.explanation: This is the laboratory (tempat) + where + clause (we conduct experiments).

simple.prompt: The laptop ___ I purchased last week has exceptional battery performance.
simple.explanation: 'That' dapat digunakan sebagai relative pronoun untuk merujuk pada benda dalam defining relative clause.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan relative pronoun 'when' untuk waktu.
simple.targetSentence: I remember the day when we first launched the product.
simple.explanation: I remember the day (waktu) + when + clause (we first launched the product).

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog dengan relative clause yang menghilangkan pronoun objek (omission).
dialogue: Have you inspected the revised schematic diagram?
Yes, the diagram ___ this morning appears completely accurate.
intermediate.explanation: Dalam defining relative clause, jika relative pronoun berfungsi sebagai OBJEK (you emailed [which] to me), pronoun tersebut BISA dan umum dihilangkan (omitted): 'the diagram you emailed me'.
hints: Pronoun objek 'which/that' dapat dihilangkan secara alami.
Pilihan 'you emailed me' langsung menyatu tanpa pronoun.

intermediate.prompt: Defining vs Non-defining: 'Dr. Emily Watson, ___ joined our research institute last month, received an international award.'
intermediate.explanation: Dalam Non-defining relative clause (diapit tanda koma dan memberi informasi tambahan tentang orang tertentu), WAJIB menggunakan 'who'. Kata 'that' DILARANG digunakan dalam klausa di antara tanda koma.
hints: Kata 'that' tidak boleh dipakai diapit koma.

intermediate.prompt: The regional headquarters, ___ was constructed in 1995, is undergoing major renovations.
intermediate.explanation: Dalam Non-defining clause untuk benda (diapit koma), WAJIB menggunakan 'which', BUKAN 'that'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat non-defining dengan tanda koma.
intermediate.targetSentence: Paris which is the capital of France attracts millions of tourists.
intermediate.explanation: Subject (Paris) + non-defining clause (which is the capital of France) + main verb (attracts millions of tourists).
hints: Mulai dengan 'Paris which is the capital of France'.

intermediate.prompt: The candidate with ___ I spoke yesterday seemed exceptionally qualified.
intermediate.explanation: Ketika preposisi diletakkan tepat di depan relative pronoun untuk merujuk pada orang (formal preposition placement), WAJIB menggunakan bentuk objektif 'whom': 'with whom', BUKAN *with who.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan preposisi di akhir klausa relatif (informal / conversational).
intermediate.targetSentence: The topic that we talked about was fascinating.
intermediate.explanation: The topic (benda) + that we talked about (preposisi di akhir) + was fascinating.
hints: Mulai dengan 'The topic that we talked about'.

intermediate.prompt: Pilih relative pronoun yang tepat untuk merujuk pada seluruh klausa sebelumnya.
dialogue: The client approved the budget in less than twenty-four hours.
That's wonderful, ___ will allow us to start procurement immediately.
intermediate.explanation: Untuk merujuk kembali pada SELURUH KLAUSA ATAU SITUASI sebelumnya (sentential relative clause), gunakan 'which' setelah tanda koma: ', which will allow us...'.
hints: Merujuk pada keseluruhan peristiwa yang disebutkan sebelumnya.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan penggunaan 'that' di dalam non-defining relative clause.
complex.draft: My primary smartphone, that I purchased two months ago, suddenly malfunctioned.
options: My primary smartphone, which I purchased two months ago, suddenly malfunctioned.
My primary smartphone that I purchased two months ago suddenly malfunctioned.
Both options above are grammatically correct ways to fix the sentence.
complex.explanation: 'That' tidak boleh berada di dalam klausa non-defining berkoma. Perbaikannya bisa mengganti 'that' dengan 'which' (jika non-defining), ATAU menghilangkan tanda koma (jika defining clause).
hints: Kedua opsi perbaikan adalah sah secara gramatikal.

complex.prompt: Reduced Relative Clause: 'The delegates ___ at the diplomatic summit represented fifty nations.'
complex.explanation: Relative clause aktif ('who were participating' atau 'who participated') dapat dipadatkan (reduced) menjadi present participle (-ing) saja: 'The delegates participating at the summit...'.
hints: Pemadatan klausa relatif aktif menjadi bentuk participle -ing.

complex.prompt: Reduced Passive Relative Clause: 'All goods ___ through this logistics hub are subjected to customs inspection.'
complex.explanation: Relative clause pasif ('which are shipped') dipadatkan menjadi past participle (V3) saja: 'All goods shipped through this hub...'.
hints: Pemadatan klausa relatif pasif (which are shipped).

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan reduced relative clause pasif.
complex.targetSentence: The documents submitted yesterday are being reviewed.
complex.explanation: The documents + reduced passive (submitted yesterday) + are being reviewed.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kekeliruan penggunaan 'what' sebagai relative pronoun penjelas kata benda.
complex.draft: The innovative solution what the engineer proposed saved millions of dollars.
options: The innovative solution that the engineer proposed saved millions of dollars.
The innovative solution which the engineer proposed saved millions of dollars.
Both options above are correct because 'what' cannot have an antecedent noun.
complex.explanation: 'What' adalah nominal relative pronoun yang bermakna 'the thing which' dan TIDAK PERNAH memiliki kata benda penjelas (antecedent) di depannya. Karena sudah ada noun 'The innovative solution', gunakan 'that' atau 'which'.

complex.prompt: Quantifier + of whom / of which: 'The university admitted two hundred doctoral candidates, most ___ were international scholars.'
complex.explanation: Struktur partitif formal menggabungkan quantifier + of whom (untuk orang) atau of which (untuk benda): 'most of whom were international scholars'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog teknis dengan partitive relative clause untuk benda.
dialogue: How many server units were evaluated during the stress test?
We evaluated sixty physical servers, all ___ passed with zero failover latency.
complex.explanation: Untuk benda jamak (servers), struktur partitif formal menggunakan 'all of which', BUKAN *all of that atau *all of whom.
